cohort: 331 pregnant women with epilepsy (PWWE) and 102 pregnant controls (PC)
finding: While PWWE and PC had similar rates of cesarean delivery overall, unlabored cesarean rates were higher among PWWE in non-recruitment hospitals, suggesting that perinatal expertise might influence delivery mode in this population.
mod_finding: Unlabored cesarean rates were higher among women with epilepsy, suggesting that provider preference may influence delivery mode among women with epilepsy; type and amount of antiepileptic drug was not associated with mode of delivery.
